adoption: First-class native BP instruction/ABI profile; no original App, renderer, image/text algorithms, decoder or mixer is linked. Two native metadata tables are adopted verbatim. The bounded bytecode execution/host publication seam is maintained here.
limits: Only strict loose BP header images (16 MiB), one module and one cooperative thread; not Buriko scenario-script interpreter.
1 MiB frame/raw memory; 4096 native operand ring slots; 4096 return records. No heap or original save translation.
Unknown instructions and native calls fail explicitly and remain unacknowledged.
Adapter maps bitmap formats 1/2 (7 aliases 1), direct image load, background, normal sprite draw/position/opacity/order/visibility; not all native graphics.
Plain native font-0 text uses shared fixed-cell/GlyphRun state; no proprietary font, markup/ruby/kinsoku/shadow/vertical or matching native glyph-metric claim.
Native timers, key polling and yield are mapped. BGM direct file preload is worker-prepared and full native volume/once-only transport is mapped; no complete audio ABI claim.
No real BGI game has been run. Synthetic native BP execution is not complete BGI compatibility.
